stem.text: Two signals approach each other, as shown.

stem.alt: Two sketched signal traces, each with a horizontal arrow beneath it. The left trace has a dip followed by a tall peak and points right; the right trace has a single dip and points left.

stem.text: At one instant, the signals completely overlap.
According to the principle of superposition, what is the shape of the resulting signal at this instant?

A.alt: Sketched signal trace: a dip, a small step up, then a tall peak.

B.alt: Sketched signal trace: a flat horizontal line.

C.alt: Sketched signal trace: a deep wide dip followed by a tall peak.

D.alt: Sketched signal trace: a shallow dip followed by a tall peak.
